verdict.rationale: There is no documented sandbox or test environment. Two features can be stitched into a workaround: the open-source gateway runs locally with a single command (`npx @portkey-ai/gateway`), and controls exist at the workspace level, separate from the org, which hints at environment separation. Prompt management is pitched for 'developing, testing, and deploying', but nothing states that test traffic or logs are kept apart from production data. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test-mode environment, documented isolation of test logs and data from production, test API keys or mock providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
